INSERT INTO live.streams
               (session_id, provider, kind, status, embed_id, locale, is_primary, started_at)
           VALUES ($1, 'youtube', 'live', $4::text::live.stream_status,
                   'video-' || $2::text || '-' || platform.uuid_v7()::text, $2, $3, now())
        RETURNING id
